evidence.claim: Nineteen actual unchanged API call sites bind to original source-extracted signatures.
validate_transition returns parent,certificate only after terminal hash/anchor, candidate tag, complete update, equal old learner identity/config, and progress proof checks.

The worker calls unchanged check_frozen with exact historical D2 config and original root; validate_terminal_receipt and validate_transition use the exact eligible D1 terminal anchor. No failed D2 checkpoint is loaded.
Teacher/Adam construction precedes strict D1 restore, which restores Python, NumPy, CPU, MPS RNG; bitwise CPU fingerprints validate all restored state before environment construction.
Actual retained terminal D1 JSON matches all six hardcoded parent counters and exact checkpoint hash; the exact final D1 boundary stream contains 64 abandoned episodes and 64 next episode indices.
Environment kwargs change only the historical run_seed; fresh initial indices and existing exclusions are retained; unchanged verify_training_env does not invoke legacy validate_config.

Checkpoint make_state fields match accessed next_episode_indices, abandoned_episodes, model/Adam/RNG fields; checkpointing does not reset live native environments. Generic serialization supports the new full identity envelope.
Entry comparison accepts reordered rows by seed/index and rejects a change in each of the nine fields. Deterministic evaluation restores model training mode and does not sample actions.
Checkpoint+evaluation verifies preserved RNG, model, Adam and live environment metadata before entry control permits any rollout. Checkpoint file hash is reverified before the long-only certificate.

collect_rollout preserves returned observations for the next update. Existing TrainingEnvLog tracks actual decisions/raw frames and native completion/reset records. PPO complete counters increment only after successful complete progress; partial Adam steps remain separately reported.
All 75 legacy input hashes match original files and capsule mirrors; new identity document SHA and checkpoint semantic identity hash are distinct and verified.

limitations: No Torch/NumPy/project module import, checkpoint deserialization, real teacher/native/MPS execution, gameplay, training, or real tensor/optimizer restoration occurred in this review.
The fingerprint check exercises duck-typed tensor method flow, not actual CPU/MPS tensor conversion. Real model/Adam/RNG equality and entry determinism remain mandatory one-shot runtime checks.

New checkpoints inherit historical run_context.consumed_wall_seconds because the controller copies D1 context. It is not the new long-run budget clock and is never read by the new authority; use new worker/supervisor wall receipts for long-run accounting.
Guard sampling concurrency/resource behavior and finalization/owned-writer proof are outside this learner/API audit. No campaign launch recommendation transfers beyond this bounded scope.
scope: Read-only static source/JSON review and independent stdlib-only API/signature/control/fingerprint checks. Supervisor lifecycle/absolute-deadline audit is handled separately.
